title: Optimizing Software in C++
subtitle: An optimization guide for Windows, Linux and Mac platforms
author: Agner Fog
description: The first of Agner Fog's five optimization manuals. A practical guide to writing fast C++: choosing platforms and compilers, the cost of language constructs, memory access, vectorization, and multithreading, grounded in real measurements.
